components.name: HeroCard
components.description: A hero on a card. The title, subtitle, actions and trailing art each sit at one of nine positions (they share `position` unless given their own), over any stack of layers: `layers` takes Surface layer data, and children take layer components such as Gradient, Noise or Shader.

props.name: title
props.description: The headline, set in Heading's display style.

props.name: actions
props.description: Calls to action, usually one or two Buttons.

props.name: leading
props.description: Above the title, in the title's position: an eyebrow or badge.

props.name: subtitlePosition
props.description: Where the subtitle sits. Follows `position` when left out.

props.name: actionsPosition
props.description: Where the actions sit. Follow `position` when left out.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Art that sits in the layout: a cut-out image, illustration or UI card.

props.name: trailingPosition
props.description: Where the trailing art sits. Default `end`, beside a `start` title.

props.name: layers
props.description: Painted bottom to top under the content, unless a layer is `over`.

examples.title: tone outline · no layers
examples.code:
<HeroCard
  tone="outline"
  position="center"
  level={1}
  title="One board for every crew and job"
  subtitle="Hours, jobs and payroll in one place."
  actions={<Button size="lg">Start free</Button>}
/>
